criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Names the subject, choice, and scale immediately.

criteria.name: Subject and decision significance for Texas
criteria.notes: Connects a funded Austin-led center to real operating environments.

criteria.name: Identity and decision fidelity
criteria.notes: NSF and UT records align on PI, director, recipient, and design.

criteria.name: Source quality and independence
criteria.notes: Official award plus institutional detail and independent reporting.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Shows why deployment design changes both evidence and governance.

criteria.name: Concrete next check
criteria.notes: Requests a site roster and operating safeguards, though no release date is public.

criteria.name: LinkedIn readability
criteria.notes: Short paragraphs and a clear progression from choice to proof.

criteria.name: Specific engagement question
criteria.notes: Asks about a concrete disclosure before deployment.

criteria.name: Credibility and proportionality
criteria.notes: Separates the funded design from unproven deployment results.
